name: Jeremoth
overview: Jeremoth is a male figure from the tribe of Benjamin, identified specifically as the son of Elpaal according to 1 Chronicles 8:14. Beyond this unique attribute, Scripture does not provide additional personal details or notable activities concerning him.
namesAndTitles: The name Jeremoth means 'height,' which may imply stature or prominence, though the text does not elaborate further. Another related name, Jeroham, meaning 'he will be compassionate,' appears in the same genealogical context but refers to a different individual.
familyAndRelationships: Jeremoth is explicitly recorded as the son of Elpaal. Additional familial connections are inferred through relationships with individuals such as Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah, Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri, suggesting a broader family network within the tribe of Benjamin as noted in 1 Chronicles 8.
scriptureSignificance: Jeremoth's significance lies primarily in his place within the genealogical records of the tribe of Benjamin, as preserved in 1 Chronicles 8. These genealogies serve to trace the lineage and tribal heritage of God's people, affirming the continuity of His covenant promises through the descendants of Benjamin. While Jeremoth himself is not highlighted for specific deeds, his inclusion underscores the faithfulness of God in preserving His chosen line.
